home.name: Ericles Willian
home.intro: Developing modern, robust and high-performance interfaces. Specialist in transforming ideas into clean code and smooth digital experiences.

about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I am a Web & Mobile Developer with over 4 years of experience building scalable, high-performance interfaces and user-centered solutions (UX/UI). My career bridges modern Front-End precision with robust Back-End integration.
about.paragraph2: Currently, I work within Close-Up International handling complex Micro Frontend architectures using TypeScript, React, Node.js, and Java. I specialize in performance optimization, legacy code refactoring, automated testing (Jest/Vitest), and advanced component design.
about.paragraph3: Driven by continuous learning and innovation, I leverage Agile methodologies (Scrum) alongside AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery, ensuring clean, sustainable architectures built to international engineering standards.

list.name: TheInvestment
list.technologies: React Native, Expo, Typescript and Node.js
list.description: 📈 Future project - It will be a mobile application focused on investment content, with good study materials aimed at financial education.

list.name: Retro-Burgers
list.technologies: TypeScript, React, React Router, React Query, Material UI, i18next, Axios, Howler, Webpack, Vitest, Testing Library, Node.js, Express, SQLite, Sequelize.
list.description: Complete e-commerce platform with Synthwave theme from the 80s. Features a dynamic flow powered by an API with category navigation, advanced product customization with add-ons, persistent shopping cart and summary modal. Includes full internationalization support, visual theme switching with exclusive soundtracks via Howler.js, strongly typed code and unit test coverage.

list.name: Car Showcase
list.technologies: HTML, CSS, Javascript, Typescript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, HeadlessUI.
list.description: The Car Showcase website presents various types of cars, displaying comprehensive information in a well-designed format with advanced filtering, pagination support and responsiveness, allowing the site to provide an immediate response to screen changes and/or devices for an enhanced user experience.

list.name: WeatherApp
list.technologies: HTML, CSS, Javascript, Typescript, React, Axios and Material UI
list.description: The project in question is an application to check the current temperature of a city corresponding to what was typed by the user. The development of this application aims to learn and improve the use of Typescript technology, accompanied by React, Material UI and Axios libraries.

list.name: SeasonShop
list.description: The Season Shop project is a technical assessment to compete for an internship position offered by Season, which consists of developing a store with a shopping cart system, using HTML, CSS, Javascript and React technologies.

list.name: ToDoList
list.description: The ToDoList is a project that was proposed to create a task listing tool with responsive layout, with the purpose of practicing learning about initial knowledge of PHP and MySQL technologies.

list.name: CryptoConverter
list.description: The project is a currency converter from Brazilian Real (BRL) to Bitcoin (BTC) at the rate quoted on November 2, 2021, at 12:59 PM. The development of this first project aims to put into practice the knowledge acquired about programming logic and Javascript language.
